job.title: Software Engineer II, Backend
job.pay_full: $133,000 – $213,000 (Zone A), $115,000 – $184,000 (Zone B), $104,000 – $166,000 (Zone C) a year base salary, plus equity and benefits

details.about: Toast builds the all-in-one restaurant platform of cloud software and restaurant-grade hardware. Its Fintech group processes payments for restaurants, millions of dollars in transactions a day, and makes sure restaurants get paid on time. This Software Engineer II joins the Payments team to build Toast's unified payment processing platform: a single, integrated service for accepting payments across channels, built once and available to all, for existing and emerging payment methods.
duties: Design, build and deliver features for Toast's payments products
Develop automated test suites so shipped code meets a high quality bar
Roll features out to customers and monitor their success
Work with UX and product management on feature definition and design
Work with experienced engineers on design and code review
needs: 2+ years designing and implementing robust backend services in Kotlin
Proven ability to build scalable, secure APIs that integrate with internal and external systems
Knowledge of API lifecycle best practices: versioning, documentation and deprecation
Proficiency in Kotlin frameworks and libraries for backend work
Experience with microservices architecture and containerization
nice: Kotlin, or Java and willingness to learn Kotlin
details.benefits: Base salary by geographic pay zone: Zone A $133,000 – $213,000; Zone B $115,000 – $184,000; Zone C $104,000 – $166,000 a year. Starting salary depends on skills, experience and location. Total rewards also include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity and benefits.
notes: Remote in the US; ability to work East Coast hours required
